name: T1-w Template Construction
summary: Builds a group-wise anatomical template from a set of T1-weighted images with ANTs iterative nonlinear (SyN) template construction.
description: Uses ANTs iterative template construction: images are aligned (rigid/affine), registered nonlinearly to the current template, averaged into a new template, and the process repeats for the requested number of iterations. Outputs the population-average template. Use it to create a study-specific template from several subjects' images; all inputs should be the same contrast.

inputs.description: Set of T1-weighted images (one per subject) to build the template from.

parameters.description: Similarity metric used for registration to the template (for example CC, cross-correlation).
Transformation model used for registration to the template (for example SyN).

citations.text: Avants BB, Tustison NJ, Song G, Cook PA, Klein A, Gee JC. A reproducible evaluation of ANTs similarity metric performance in brain image registration. NeuroImage 54(3):2033-2044 (2011).
Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).

failure_modes.fix: Provide at least one input image.
